# Sensor Sheet

> Independent notes on HWiNFO: what the free edition does, what Pro costs, and how to read and log your PC's sensors, compiled from the vendor's own pages.

Independent guides to Hwinfo by Sensor Sheet. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Do it
- [HWiNFO download: version 8.54 installer and portable package](https://hw-info.github.io/download.html): HWiNFO 8.54 download guide: installer for Windows 7 64 bit and later, portable package for 32 bit, 64 bit and ARM64, licence terms and install steps.
- [How to check CPU and GPU temperature with HWiNFO](https://hw-info.github.io/check-temperatures.html): How to check CPU and GPU temperature with HWiNFO: start in Sensors-only mode, read the sensors window, set alerts and keep it running at startup.
- [HWiNFO logging: how to record sensors to a CSV file](https://hw-info.github.io/log-sensors.html): HWiNFO logging step by step: start the CSV sensor log, pick values with the Logged checkbox, set the polling period and open the file afterwards.

## Decide
- [HWiNFO review: what version 8.54 does and where the free edition stops](https://hw-info.github.io/review.html): HWiNFO review from the vendor's documentation: hardware inventory, sensors, logging, free edition limits, Pro pricing and a score of 8.6 out of 10.
- [HWiNFO Pro price: subscription, lifetime licence and refund terms](https://hw-info.github.io/pricing.html): HWiNFO Pro price read on hwinfo.com: subscription from $29 for the first year, renewals from $14.50, lifetime from $199, 14 day refund window.
- [HWiNFO free vs Pro: the limits and what the licence removes](https://hw-info.github.io/free-vs-pro.html): HWiNFO free vs Pro: shared memory stops after 12 hours and the OSD shows 5 items in the free edition. See what Pro removes and who needs it.

## Compare
- [HWiNFO vs HWMonitor: which hardware monitor to install](https://hw-info.github.io/hwinfo-vs-hwmonitor.html): HWiNFO vs HWMonitor compared from both vendors' pages: versions, platforms, reports, logging, remote monitoring and what the paid editions add.
- [HWiNFO alternatives: 6 hardware monitoring tools compared](https://hw-info.github.io/alternatives.html): Six HWiNFO alternatives with facts from each vendor's page: HWMonitor, HWMonitor PRO, AIDA64 Extreme, CPU-Z, Core Temp and Libre Hardware Monitor.

## Full text
- [llms-full.txt](https://hw-info.github.io/llms-full.txt): every guide on this site in plain markdown
